text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
(Our very first crossing of paths. With 
"you"... a once-in-a-lifetime moment.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: (――...This is it?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having made all necessary preparations, 
her Debut race arrived. Mejiro Ramonu's 
run was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cheers and jeers were both sparse; the 
excitement had largely drained from the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so far removed from the scene we 
had envisioned— As she sprinted across the 
turf, contrary to her fierce demeanor, she 
almost seemed to be crying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And— starting the next day, Mejiro Ramonu 
had changed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She began actively participating in 
meetings with sports journalists and 
social gatherings where race industry 
bigwigs congregate—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She, who hardly paid any mind to other 
people, was bustling about trying to build 
connections.
choice_data_list:
(That's not like her. What could be 
wrong...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—I see, so that is why you came to the 
mansion. I expect my sister will return 
from the salon shortly.
choice_data_list:
Even on your day off, huh... Do you know 
the circumstances?

Even on your day off... Do you know what's 
going on?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the details. ...Only that my 
sister is planning to hold a large-scale 
press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I widen my eyes upon receiving the guest 
list for the press conference. Not just at 
the prestigious lineup. This is—
choice_data_list:
It's far too big in scale to hold right 
after debut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"She must be that serious. ...For my dear 
sister to spare time even from her 
running."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Channeling the frustration and anger of 
not being able to offer enough love during 
the debut race into fuel—
choice_data_list: Gathering a crowd to announce something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her Make Debut, Mejiro Ramonu was 
forced to experience firsthand the decline 
of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone who loves racing from the 
bottom of her heart, she must have felt 
utterly devastated.
choice_data_list:
In that case, what Mejiro Ramonu wants to 
tell you is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah, you've arrived.
choice_data_list:
Do you intend to appeal the current 
situation at the press conference?

Are you planning to appeal the current 
situation at the press conference?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Too lukewarm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I... will start a revolution.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm lacking in everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Both the intertwining, melting heat. And 
the roars of anger, as well as the cheers 
of acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I want to love them... Yet I cannot.
choice_data_list:
If we're talking about getting the racing 
world hyped up, now's the time for all of 
us to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The light of a firefly fades away in an 
instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Hotter, fiercer... Unless it is a raging 
fire that scorches the flesh."
choice_data_list:
So that's why you're starting a 
"revolution"...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...That is the proof of my love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Clear-cut, vicious, and provoking everyone 
into baring their fangs—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I shall become the flower of evil.

text_block_list.name: Sports Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, Senpai, what's with this press 
conference...?! From racing world bigwigs 
to chairmen of famous zaibatsus—

text_block_list.name: Racing World Pundit
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to hearing what Miss Ramonu 
has to say. She will undoubtedly 
contribute greatly to the development of 
the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for gathering here today. 
Having recently made my debut—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I find myself utterly disappointed in the 
current racing world once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Empty spectator stands, a dull race devoid 
of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Allowing things to fall into such decline 
is the height of negligence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The active runners who can only put on 
races that alienate fans are just as 
guilty—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To not even feel ashamed when you fail to 
captivate the crowd."

text_block_list.name: Active Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What is this stream...?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
T-That is hard to hear. However, I believe 
the racing world is currently united in 
working together to improve the situation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—What is needed is not cooperation, but 
the existence of an absolute powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The weak should simply serve as a foil. 
Just quietly and complacently enjoy your 
handouts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If you have any objections, why not show 
me with your strength? I shall be waiting 
whenever you are ready."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...From here on out, I shall be the one to 
guide you. That shall be the new racing 
world—a new legend.
choice_data_list: We will create a new era!
We will create a new era!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the unprecedented press conference 
caused quite a stir and sparked major 
backlash from the public—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was Mejiro Ramonu's plan all along. 
Yes—by reigning as the villain herself, 
she set a fire in everyone's hearts."
